facts.text: Tento druh je aktivní v noci a žije převážně na stromech.
facts.quote: The common brushtail possum is largely arboreal and nocturnal.

facts.text: Na Nový Zéland ho lidé zavlekli v 50. letech 19. století kvůli kožešině.
facts.quote: The common brushtail possum was introduced to New Zealand in the 1850s to establish a fur industry

facts.text: Novorozené mládě měří jen 1,5 cm a váží 2 g.
facts.quote: A newborn brushtail possum is only 1.5 cm (0.6 in) long and weighs only 2 g (0.07 oz).
Females have a gestation period of 16–18 days

facts.text: Živí se nejraději listy eukalyptů, ale jí i květy, plody a semena.
facts.quote: It prefers Eucalyptus leaves, but also eats flowers, shoots, fruits, and seeds.

facts.text: V Austrálii ho ohrožují psi, lišky, kočky, varani, hadi a sovy.
facts.quote: In Australia, brushtail possums are threatened by humans, tiger quolls, dogs, foxes, cats, goannas, carpet snakes, and powerful owls.
